command:
set -eo pipefail
cd /tmp
echo '== healpy: exact HEALPix combinatorial + geometric identities =='
cat > recipe.py <<'PYEOF'
import numpy as np, sys, healpy as hp

lines=[f"healpy {hp.__version__}  (exact HEALPix identities -- zero band, not tolerance)"]
fail=[]
def chk(label,ok,detail):
    l=f"{label:22s} {detail}  [{'ok' if ok else 'FAIL'}]"; print(l); lines.append(l)
    if not ok: fail.append(label)

# 1. combinatorial: npix = 12 nside^2, exact integer
ok_npix=all(hp.nside2npix(ns)==12*ns*ns for ns in (1,2,4,16,64,256,1024))
chk("npix_12_nside2", ok_npix, "npix==12*nside^2 exact for nside 1..1024 (integer identity)")

# 2. equal-area tiling: sum of pixel areas == 4*pi, BIT-EXACT
nside=64; npix=hp.nside2npix(nside); total=hp.nside2pixarea(nside)*npix
chk("area_sum_4pi", total==4*np.pi, f"sum(areas)={total!r} == 4pi (bit-exact, rel_err={abs(total-4*np.pi)/(4*np.pi):.1e})")

# 3. nested<->ring bijection, EXHAUSTIVE over every pixel
ipix=np.arange(npix)
rt=hp.ring2nest(nside, hp.nest2ring(nside, ipix))
chk("nest_ring_bijection", np.array_equal(rt,ipix), f"nest->ring->nest identity over ALL {npix} pixels (exhaustive, not sampled)")

# 4. geometric round-trip: pix->ang->pix identity, all pixels
th,ph=hp.pix2ang(nside,ipix)
chk("pix_ang_roundtrip", np.array_equal(hp.ang2pix(nside,th,ph),ipix), f"pix->ang->pix identity over all {npix} pixels")

lines.append("SMOKE CHECK PASSED" if not fail else "SMOKE CHECK FAILED "+str(fail))
open('smoke-check.txt','w').write("\n".join(lines)+"\n")
print("SMOKE CHECK PASSED" if not fail else "SMOKE CHECK FAILED")
sys.exit(1 if fail else 0)

PYEOF
python3 recipe.py
